item.title: Implementing Cross-Account CI/CD Pipelines: DevOps Patterns for Multi-Account AWS Architectures
item.description: Here’s a scene that plays out daily in engineering teams worldwide: you’re a senior engineer at a growing SaaS company. Your team has maturely segmented production, staging, and development environments into separate AWS accounts for security and compliance reasons. However, your deployment process has become a manual nightmare of shared credentials, context switching between accounts, and error-prone coordination steps. Each release requires logging into multiple AWS consoles, remembering different IAM roles, and manually orchestrating deployments—a process that takes hours and keeps everyone on edge.
